What she’s got:

And because I believe in telling the whole story…

She has a few little character traits. 😂

The back hatch: Sometimes the power hatch opens beautifully. Other times, she prefers that you open it manually. We respect her boundaries. 😂

The sunroof: It opens and closes, but when you’re closing it, you need to give it a little helping hand as it moves forward. Again… character.

The driver’s side mirror: A little loose after a brief disagreement with the car wash, but it is still fully functional.

The exterior: There are a few light scratches from my dogs enthusiastically greeting me over the years. They were just happy to see me. ❤️

So no, she isn’t brand new. She has 232,000 miles and a few stories to tell.

But she has been my dependable workhorse for years, she’s been maintained, she’s AWD, she’s comfortable, she’s loaded up with the Limited features, and she’s ready for someone else to put some miles on her.

If you need an affordable vehicle that can get you where you need to go without spending a fortune, come take a look at her.

I’d really love to see her go to someone who will appreciate her as much as I have.

Imagine moving into a home where the renovation is complete, the furnishings are thoughtfully selected, and downtown galleries, dining, and live music are within walking distance. At 1014 3rd Street, that next chapter is ready to begin.

📍 1014 3rd Street | Paonia, Colorado
💲 Offered at $725,000
3 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | Approximately 2,032 Sq. Ft.
Attached 1-Car Garage | MLS #832406

Completely remodeled from the studs with high-end finishes, this 1955 home brings together established neighborhood appeal and the comfort of extensively updated spaces. From premium appliances to inviting outdoor areas, there is so much here to appreciate.

✨ A RENOVATION THAT GOES WELL BEYOND APPEARANCES

Remodeled in 2024, the home features updated exterior finishes, roofing, doors, windows, and mechanical systems. Inside, quality materials and thoughtful improvements create a setting that feels polished and comfortable.

Enjoy:
• Premium Bosch kitchen appliances
• Radiant floor heating
• Efficient ductless heating and cooling systems
• An on-demand water heater
• A separate dining area for everyday meals and memorable gatherings
• Practical storage, including a pantry and walk-in closet

🛋️ BEAUTIFUL FURNISHINGS INCLUDED

Furnishings from Restoration Hardware, Crate & Barrel, and Pottery Barn add another layer of appeal. This is an opportunity to step into a thoughtfully furnished home with much of the work of getting settled already done.

☀️ EVERYDAY COMFORT WITH SPACE FOR COMPANY

The main level features two bedrooms, one bathroom, and the primary living areas, keeping daily life conveniently on one floor.

The finished walkout basement provides additional living space, a third bedroom, and a second bathroom—offering welcome separation for visiting guests or room to spread out. An office/den and available Elevate fiber-optic internet also support working from home.

🌿 A BACKYARD WORTH SLOWING DOWN FOR

Start the morning on the deck, spend an afternoon tending the garden, or gather outside beneath the shade. Professionally landscaped grounds, a spacious lawn, and a fenced backyard create an inviting outdoor extension of the home.

One Stewart Ditch irrigation share, an irrigation pump, and lawn sprinklers help support the beautiful grounds.

🎨 TWO SEPARATE SPACES FOR YOUR IDEAS

A matching outbuilding is divided into two separate studio or storage spaces. Picture a place for creative projects, hobbies, seasonal belongings, or the supplies you would love to organize outside the house.

An attached garage and off-street parking add everyday convenience.

🎶 MAKE PAONIA PART OF YOUR DAILY ROUTINE

Walk downtown for a meal, explore local art, or enjoy an evening of live music. Here in the North Fork Valley, small-town living comes with a vibrant creative community and Western Colorado scenery close at hand.

With no HOA or covenants listed, this property offers a compelling combination of extensive updates, included furnishings, versatile space, and an in-town location.

If you have been searching for a beautifully finished home that lets you spend more time enjoying where you live, put this one on your list.

Something went wrong? Oppression.

Someone else succeeded? Privilege.

Sometimes somebody screwed you.

Sometimes you got lucky.

Sometimes life screwed you for no reason whatsoever.

“What could I have done differently?”

No accountability. No introspection. No change required. Just sit patiently while the universe determines whose fault you are.

Circumstances matter. Injustice matters. Other people's actions matter.

And so do your choices.
